title: Dictation transcription capabilities
description: What a deployment offers for record-to-text dictation (1.1.0): whether the host should show a record button, whether recognition is local or external, the maximum clip length, and the only accepted audio shape. Dictation is not the voice-conversation WebSocket: there is no VAD, the user's record and stop are the segmentation, the transcript is returned for the user to edit, and AlixAI never submits it as a turn. Raw audio is not retained.

available.description: true when POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/dictations can succeed for this scope; false when the host should hide the record control.

locality.description: local: speech recognition runs in the deployment. external: an operator-enabled external STT may be used under the egress and budget rules. none: no recogniser is available (available is false).

max_seconds.description: Longest clip the route accepts, in whole seconds. Default 60; the operator may lower or raise it. The body-size limit is derived from this and the fixed PCM rate.

sample_rate_hz.description: Only accepted sample rate for the WAV body.

format.description: Only accepted Content-Type and container: WAV wrapping PCM s16le mono.

languages.description: BCP 47 language tags the recogniser accepts as a language query hint. Empty when available is false.

allOf.description: When nothing is available, locality is none.
